gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-familjen-grotesk: Relaxed and personal, Fuzzy Bubbles looks like bent tubing. Familjen Grotesk is a lively sans-serif with half-finished bowls, and it is best given a modest size so its tall lowercase stays crisp.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-technor: Fuzzy Bubbles hands over rounded, inviting letters drawn like a technical pen line. Technor is the surprise, a sans-serif of glowing neon-tube strokes whose cool geometry makes the handwriting feel warmer.
gen-gf-ga-maamli-fs-rowan: Blunt, loud and unfussy up top. Rowan, a classic serif with generous curve openings and thin strokes half the weight of its thick ones, gives Ga Maamli a literary, friendly counterweight.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-epunda-slab: Gabarito squeezes out its letters like toothpaste. Epunda Slab, a serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, carries a paragraph with dignified, classic ease.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads like a literary text serif, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. Gabarito's tubelike heading sits above it comfortably at a bigger size.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, Glegoo has big counters and wide, unclosed curves under Gabarito's expressive, wire-bent s shapes. Both fonts keep their letters wide open, so the page feels connected.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-hanuman: Traditional and refined, Hanuman's high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals give a text serif its poise. Under Gabarito's open-ended display strokes, a long page would feel steady and unhurried.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a text serif with open-ended curves and an unusually large x-height, which gives its lines a classic editorial feel. Against Gabarito's marker-like constant line, that open, generous lowercase is the strongest quality.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, Noticia Text is a serif with big visible entrances into each curve. Gabarito, drawn as if traced with a marker, would feel thin if the heading were made small, while the body stays sturdy.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-piazzolla: Gabarito leads with expressive, one-nib strokes whose open terminals let the counters flow outward. Piazzolla, a refined serif with a lowercase nearly matching its capitals and a pried-open e, steadies the page beneath.
